scope: Offline source qualification only; no real bulk source run, future outcome read, network request, or market effect calculation
implemented: CLI requires asset-growth-source-run/1 contract, frozen design SHA and bound old audit, source index, panel, parser, rules and reviewed notice decisions
July formation axis must be exactly 600 historical codes for each year 2015 through 2025, 6600 distinct rows; output is source-only and create-only on named external device and UUID

For each old GP-qualified row, exact current latest annual IDs must match old audit; latest prior annual is selected without fallback after failed PDF or field; source PDF and prepared document hashes and identities are checked

Consolidated current and comparative total assets use the frozen parser's money token and scale; both current and prior full reports must qualify and comparative must exactly equal prior report current assets; GP revenue, cost, assets and ratio are read back against old audit

Same-day annual candidates must agree; unknown notices need both fiscal years and both publications after the event plus matching cross-report amounts; explicit affected asset years block absent exact resolved full ID
Outputs panel.csv, source-pairs.json, coverage.json and manifest.json contain qualification and source evidence only, with unknown rows and reason counts retained

checks: latest failed report not replaced with older report
unit, note-number, adjusted or reversed columns
year-start amount requires exact prior-report agreement
dual-period notice boundary and exact review hash
source-only contract rejection and Python parser hash-only binding
annual summary/English exclusion, true ambiguous annual notice, notice mentioning annual report, and revised full annual as a version

review_repair.cause: The first notice predicate treated 7346 excluded annual summaries or English reports with unknown year as unresolved notices, and would count a full revised annual tagged correction twice. The frozen source index has 7275 annual summaries and 69 annual English files in the largest unknown-year groups, plus six annual/correction dual-category files. The original preparation schema calls a qualified full annual suspected_full_text and annual_candidate_evidence.status suspected; a revised full annual sample uses both values.
review_repair.change: Read the old parser as a byte-bound Python module, not JSON. Exclude records with excluded_doc_kind from notice events; distinguish revised full annual versions from correction notices and retain genuinely ambiguous annual titles. Latest failed full reports remain candidates and cannot trigger fallback.
review_repair.evidence_scope: Read-only source-index metadata and three representative prepared record metadata examples; no real 6600-row source run or future outcomes

limits: Synthetic tests establish specified code branches, not real 6600-row coverage or source truth; the root controller must review before authorizing the separate source run
Only the six decisions with exact accepted review identity may clear known notices; other business or correction claims stay conservative unknown unless an exact review is added to the frozen scope
Unreviewed notice measurement recovery reports internally consistent later numbers but keeps continuing scope unknown and does not certify financial authenticity
Asset expansion is reported balance-sheet change, not organic investment; mergers, accounting perimeter and foreign-exchange effects remain possible
No ETF, account, trading, market return or production conclusion follows from source qualification
